# Coin98

> Coin98 is a crypto super-app offering a non-custodial multi-chain wallet, DEX aggregator (SwapX), on-chain perpetual futures (Coin98 Perps), Visa debit card (Fusion Card), token staking (PowerPool), and physical hardware wallet (Zen Card). Supports 80+ blockchains across iOS, Android, browser extension, Telegram, and web.

## Products

- [Coin98 Super Wallet](https://coin98.com/wallet): Non-custodial multi-chain wallet for iOS, Android, and Chrome extension, supporting 80+ blockchains with built-in swap, staking, NFT management, and dApp browser.
- [Coin98 AI Wallet](https://coin98.com/coin98-ai-wallet): AI-powered wallet featuring autonomous agents (Cypheus) for swap, transfer, staking, and on-chain anomaly detection.
- [SwapX](https://coin98.com/swap): DEX aggregator routing trades across 50+ DEXs for best-price execution, available on web and mobile.
- [Coin98 Perps](https://coin98.com/futures/hyperliquid): On-chain perpetual futures trading powered by Hyperliquid with up to 100× leverage, embedded in the Coin98 wallet.
- [Coin98 Markets](https://coin98.com/markets): Real-time crypto market data, price charts, token screening, and trading pair discovery.
- [Fusion Card](https://coin98.com/fusion-card): Visa debit card linked to a non-custodial wallet, enabling real-world spending of crypto assets.
- [PowerPool](https://docs.coin98.com/products/coin98-staking): C98 token staking protocol with fixed-rate and dynamic-rate options for on-chain yield.
- [Zen Card](https://docs.coin98.com/products/physical-cards/hybrid-wallet): Physical hybrid wallet with NFC for cold storage and tap-to-pay everyday use.
- [Coin98 Vault](https://docs.coin98.com/products/coin98-vault): Token distribution tool for creating vesting schedules, airdrops, and sponsored-gas claims.
- [Coin98 Telegram Wallet](https://docs.coin98.com/products/coin98-telegram-wallet): Non-custodial wallet embedded in Telegram for managing tokens, swapping, and peer-to-peer transfers.
- [Referral Program](https://coin98.com/referral): Universal referral program rewarding users for growing the Coin98 ecosystem.

## Documentation

- [Coin98 Docs](https://docs.coin98.com): Full end-user documentation covering all Coin98 products, features, and how-to guides.
- [Developer Guide](https://docs.coin98.com/developer-guide): Integration guides and SDK references for connecting dApps to Coin98 across 40+ blockchains.
- [Coin98 Adapter](https://docs.coin98.com/developer-guide/coin98-adapter): React and Next.js adapter for dApp wallet connection, with hooks for wallet state and modals.
- [C98 Token](https://docs.coin98.com/products/coin98-token): Coin98's native utility token — issuance standards, how to acquire, storage options, and trading venues.
- [Coin98 Blog](https://coin98.com/blog): Product announcements, tutorials, ecosystem news, and DeFi research.
